caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate wooden goblet centered on a plain, light beige background. The goblet is rendered in brown tones, with visible wood grain texture throughout its surface. The bowl of the goblet is large, rounded, and smoothly finished, transitioning into a narrower stem that expands into a decorative, rounded knob at the center. This knob is adorned with carved details and ornamental designs. The base of the goblet is broad and circular, featuring additional carved decorations and scalloped edges. There are no other objects or elements in the composition.
title: Goblet
